messages:
maria: Heads up — customers hitting duplicate downstream side-effects from our JS onboarding sample when token rotation + 429 happen together. Repro'd locally.
ben: yikes. can you outline the exact sequence? makes it easier to propose mitigations.
maria: steps: (1) start sampleapp using short-lived demo token (2) flood /generate to create backpressure (3) token expires mid-flight, sample refreshes token, some requests get 429, SDK retries after refresh and server treats them as new requests => duplicated webhook deliveries.
carol: does the SDK currently attach any idempotency header or correlation id on first attempt?
maria: no, sample is intentionally minimal so it doesn't set Idempotency-Key. SDK retry logic just replays the body.
sam: two low-effort fixes: (A) show adding an Idempotency-Key in the sample app and persist it across retries, (B) expose a replay-signal header from SDK so servers can dedupe based on replay flag + correlation id.
ben: I prefer doing both in the sample: teach idempotency by default, and also include optional replay-signal for legacy servers. docs should explain when each is appropriate.
carol: agree. for the replay-signal pattern we should standardize on headers: `x-rw-replay-id` (uuid) and `x-rw-replay` (boolean) sent only on retry attempts. server can use replay-id to lookup first delivery.
maria: will prototype: add a small utility that generates idempotency key once per logical operation and stores it in the request context so retries reuse it. sample config toggles: IDEMPOTENCY_ENABLED=true, REPLAY_SIGNAL=false by default.
sam: SDK ergonomics: add `safeReplayWindowMs` config that disables client-side replay of non-idempotent requests after X ms. default 3000ms. reason: if token rotated long after original send we probably shouldn't replay.
ben: great call. also add telemetry event `sdk.replay_attempt` with replay_id and reason (e.g., 429+auth-refresh) so ops can surface spikes without exposing payload. event must be PII-free.
carol: tests: we need an integration test that simulates token expiry mid-flight and asserts server only processed webhook once. also a unit test for header emission logic.
maria: noted. will include tests + README section explaining sample choices and tradeoffs (when to use idempotency vs replay-signal).
ci-bot: Created issue #3490: add idempotency + replay-signal to onboarding JS sample (maria).
ben: can you also add a short troubleshooting blurb to the support KB: "If duplicates reported, ask for x-rw-replay-id and server delivery timestamps". helps support triage.
maria: will add KB entry and open PR after lunch. pushing small patch: sample now sets Idempotency-Key and emits replay headers on retries behind a flag.
sam: once PR is up ping me, I'll sanity-check SDK config naming and default values.
carol: nice. small DX win and will reduce customer tickets.
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/523 — includes tests and docs.
ben: reviewed, left minor wording nit in README. CI flaky test failing on Windows but unrelated.
maria: thanks — will fix the nit and re-run CI. :thumbsup:
carol: follow-up: we should consider adding a server-side dedupe guide for partners that can't add idempotency. short KB with examples using replay headers and a sample dedupe table.
maria: adding to backlog. thanks everyone.
